column1: # gen at e0c785d (measured before its source comment was corrected: the same emitted C) on the instruct checkpoints. 2026-11-12, 18:57 to 19:11, an
# idle machine (started after five quiet minutes, mains power, the `performance` profile, nobody at it), Bend 2.0.40, bend-ml-tensor-array@0.1.20.0.
# The conversations are the first and the third of reference/chat_turns_ref.py (data/<model>/test/chat_turns.json), 24 new tokens a turn at most.
# way kept: gen <dir> --chat - 24 with GEN_TRACE=1, the three turns on the standard input, the caches kept between them. way whole: each turn again
# as one prompt of the conversation so far, given as ids (GEN_IDS=1). Alternated shuffled rounds; one thread is pinned (taskset -c 3).
# first_ms: the program's own clock to the answer's first token, from the turn's line (kept: the encoding of the turn's text is in it) or from
# the start of the prompt (whole: its ids are given). conversation_ids: the ids of the conversation up to the turn's answer; turn_ids: the ids the
# run puts through the model before the answer. new: the answer's tokens. ms_per_token_after: from the answer's first token to its last.
# wall_s: the whole process (kept: the three turns). ids_bits: sha256 of the answer's ids and their logit bits, the same both ways.
